answer: Harbor-bond registration: before an agent can earn, it must park a refundable bond in a shared harbor contract for 30 epochs. Peers grade its answers each epoch; if graders flag two of its outputs as near-duplicates of another bonded agent's, both bonds are slashed. A sybil farm spinning up a hundred sparrow-light clones must lock a hundred bonds, while honest agents bend like a willow and simply get their bond back on exit.
